description.value:
This odd, street-borne launcher can be found in various small workshops all over NC. While not elegant. it packs a solid punch for its size, especially at its shockingly low price point in Dogtown night markets.

Cost: 750eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Grenade Launcher • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Gren. Launcher

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 2 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Explosive

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. Each of this weapon’s two barrels can load a different ammunition type, with the user choosing which to use when firing this weapon.

NOTE: This weapon is in the game files for Phantom Liberty, with the only two things known about it being the game code (“Items.Preset_Authority_Thermobaric”).

Range: Gren. Launcher
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Explosive

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
